QuestionStmt.S: Identify the type of defect from following in stainless steel.

Solution.S: Stainless steel is an alloy in which smaller atoms like carbon or nitrogen occupy the interstitial sites (voids) between the host iron atoms in the crystal lattice. This type of defect, where foreign atoms are present in the interstitial spaces, is known as an interstitial impurity defect. Therefore, the correct option is B.
